title: Chapter 185 The Aura Of Disaster
content:
Chapter 185 The Aura Of Disaster

"Spiritual rhyme, where did you come from?"

Lu Daosheng asked as he looked at Yan Lingyun beside him.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun did not hide it.

"This is an unexpected gain from the chaotic void in my first life."

"And I also rely on its credit, so that I can live out the second and third lives."

Hearing Yan Lingyun's words, Lu Daosheng did not relax his vigilance.

"Lingyun, you should know what this thing is, right?"

Yan Lingyun nodded.

"The legendary thing, the product of the first birth of the world, the Chaos Pearl."

When Yan Lingyun first obtained the Chaos Pearl, she knew the identity of this thing.

It was also from that moment that Yan Lingyun had completely risen, and her potential in her body was constantly explored under the influence of the Chaos Pearl.

It can be said that it was the Chaos Pearl that made her what she is now.

However, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

"This is indeed a Chaos Bead, but it is contaminated with unclean things, so now it is easy to get out of control."

"Once you lose control, the consequences will be unimaginable."

At that time, the Chaos Pearl will explode and countless worlds will be erased.

No wonder the heavenly way in this world needs to launch the World-Destroying Calamity Bell after feeling this slight breath.

What is about to be destroyed is not Yan Lingyun, but the Chaos Pearl in Yan Lingyun's body.

Lu Daosheng's words made Yan Lingyun a little shocked.

This treasure that has protected her for so long is so dangerous.

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly held the Chaos Bead tightly and began to exert force.

Suddenly, the Chaos Bead began to tremble wildly.

"You, what are you going to do? Do you want to die together?!"

On the side, when he saw this scene, Tiandao was frightened and the whole world began to tremble wildly with the fear of Tiandao.

However, Lu Daosheng seemed to have not heard it, and the power in his hand was still increasing.

finally.

Buzz —

An illusory villain slowly emerged from the Chaos Bead.

Spirit, the spirit of Chaos Pearl.

The higher the level of treasure, the more intelligent the more you will be born.

As a legendary treasure, the Chaos Pearl is naturally also spiritual.

However, the spirit of the Chaos Pearl was a little abnormal at this moment, looking extremely weak, like a young man who had been seven times a night.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"really."

"Daosheng, what's wrong with it?"

On the side, Yan Lingyun also noticed the unusualness and said with some concern.

I have been with the Chaos Pearl for so long, so it is naturally impossible for me to have no feelings for it.

In fact, when she first met the Chaos Bead, she had also communicated with the Chaos Bead.

Chaos Bead only told her one thing.

Take it away.

After that, the Chaos Bead never said anything again.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the Chaos Pearl Spirit and said in a deep voice: "It is stained with the aura of disaster."

The aura of disaster!

Hearing the aura of disaster, Yan Lingyun's face changed drastically.

That's not a good thing.

Even legendary treasures like Chaos Pearl have become like this when they are contaminated with the aura of disaster. You can imagine how terrifying the aura of disaster is.

"Daosheng, do you have a way to remove it?"

Yan Lingyun said in a trembling voice.

If something happened to the Chaos Pearl, the whole world would suffer, and she didn't want to see something happening to the Chaos Pearl.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng immediately smiled crookedly.

Finally, the question was on the spot.

"Lingyun, who am I? I am your man. There is nothing in this world that I can't do!"

Lu Daosheng laughed.

And these words also calmed Yan Lingyun.

On the side, Tiandao was a little unbelievable.

A ray of disaster is enough to completely destroy him in an instant. How could such a fierce thing be solved?

It’s not that he looked down on Lu Daosheng, but that it was really incredible.

However, he was still disappointed.

It can only be said that this world is too small, limiting the imagination of the way of heaven.

Lu Daosheng was about to take action when he suddenly thought of something.

"Lingyun, it's not convenient to take action here, wait for me."

Yan Lingyun nodded obediently, and then Lu Daosheng disappeared directly from the spot.

After Lu Daosheng left, Yan Lingyun turned her head and looked at Tiandao beside her.

Feeling Yan Lingyun's aggressive gaze, the Heavenly Dao trembled slightly, "What are you looking at?"

"I want to hit you."

Heavenly Way:...

Meanwhile, in a certain space.

Everything here seemed extremely strange. At this time, Lu Daosheng's figure slowly appeared.

"The energy of disaster, haha, it seems that someone is planning it."

Lu Daosheng sneered.

His expression gradually became cold.

Even if this thing is given to Wuji respect, it will probably scare him half his life.

But now, it appeared in his wife's body.

He couldn't bear this.

However, the most important thing now is how to clean up the disaster energy in this Chaos Bead.

For ordinary people, it is a bit whimsical to eliminate the disaster.

But for Lu Daosheng, there are many ways.

Among them, the most convenient one is absolute power.

In this world, there is nothing that cannot be solved by strength. If there is, it means that the strength is not enough.

boom!

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng's aura began to surge wildly.

The quiet space around it began to gradually break.

As can be seen from the naked eye, the strange aura on the Chaos Pearl has gradually dissipated a little.

This is still Lu Daosheng not making a move, and the aura of disaster has already given up.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng sneered and did not hold back at all.

"Destroy it!"

Boom!

The entire space exploded completely, and countless wanton void turbulence poured in, slapping Lu Daosheng's body frantically, but Lu Daosheng was like Mount Tai, motionless.

Squeak~

At this time, there was a sound on the Chaos Pearl.

A wisp of black air slowly overflowed from it.

In just a moment, this void was completely wiped out.

Lu Daosheng was quick-witted and grabbed the wisp of black air in his hand.

"Aura of disaster..."

Lu Daosheng looked solemn and muttered to himself.

At this time, the wisp of disaster aura still tried to invade Lu Daosheng's body, just like it invaded the Chaos Pearl at the beginning.

However, it was disappointed.

With Lu Daosheng's current strength, even if he stood still, the aura of disaster would not be able to hurt him at all.

Bang.

Lu Daosheng exerted a little force, and the aura of disaster that had invaded the Chaos Pearl for endless years was completely destroyed.

"System, this aura of disaster should have a master, right?"

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng finally chose the simplest way.

Ask the system directly.

[Host, the aura of disaster has a source, and the source is the master of this aura of disaster]

"Source?"

"You mean, the Chaos Pearl is like this because of the source of the aura of disaster?"

[Host, the source can only produce the aura of disaster, and the Chaos Pearl is like this because it was accidentally contaminated by the Chaos Pearl itself]

Hearing the system's explanation, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned.

Didn't I accidentally contaminate it?

So, I thought too much?

At this time, the Chaos Pearl Spirit finally regained consciousness.

"I, I am alive?"
